```{python}
#| echo: false
#| output: asis

import yaml
import markdown
from html import escape
from IPython.display import display, HTML

# If execute-dir: project is enabled, use:
# "content/ecocast_map.yml"
with open("../../content/ecocast_map.yml", encoding="utf-8") as f:
    data = yaml.safe_load(f) or {}

def safe(value):
    return escape(str(value or ""), quote=True)

def md(value):
    return markdown.markdown(
        str(value or ""),
        extensions=["tables", "sane_lists"]
    )

hero = data.get("hero", {})
map_data = data.get("map", {})
faq = data.get("faq", {})
downloads = data.get("downloads", {})
disclaimer = data.get("disclaimer", {})

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# MAP NAVIGATION DATA
# ----------------------------------------------------------

import json

map_dates = map_data.get("dates", [])

initial_map = (
    map_dates[0].get("url", "")
    if map_dates else ""
)

initial_label = (
    map_dates[0].get("label", "")
    if map_dates else ""
)

map_dates_json = json.dumps(map_dates).replace(
    "<", "\\u003c"
).replace(">", "\\u003e").replace("&", "\\u0026")

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# FAQ ITEMS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

faq_items = ""

for item in faq.get("questions", []):

    extra_content = ""

    if item.get("image"):
        extra_content += f"""
        <div class="cw-ecocast-map-model">
          <img src="{safe(item.get('image'))}"
               alt="{safe(item.get('image_alt'))}"
               loading="lazy">
        </div>
        """

    if item.get("links"):
        extra_content += '<ul class="cw-ecocast-map-links">'

        for link in item.get("links", []):
            label = safe(link.get("label"))
            url = link.get("url")

            if url:
                extra_content += f"""
                <li>
                  <a href="{safe(url)}"
                     target="_blank"
                     rel="noopener noreferrer">
                    {label}
                  </a>
                </li>
                """
            else:
                extra_content += f"<li>{label}</li>"

        extra_content += "</ul>"

    faq_items += f"""
    <details class="cw-ecocast-map-faq-item">

      <summary>
        <span>{safe(item.get('question'))}</span>
        <span class="cw-ecocast-map-faq-icon"
              aria-hidden="true">+</span>
      </summary>

      <div class="cw-ecocast-map-faq-answer">
        {md(item.get('answer'))}
        {extra_content}
      </div>

    </details>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# DOWNLOAD LINKS
# ----------------------------------------------------------

download_links = ""

for item in downloads.get("links", []):
    download_links += f"""
    <a class="cw-ecocast-download-link"
       href="{safe(item.get('url'))}"
       target="_blank"
       rel="noopener noreferrer">
      <span>{safe(item.get('label'))}</span>
      <span aria-hidden="true">↗</span>
    </a>
    """

# ----------------------------------------------------------
# PAGE HTML
# ----------------------------------------------------------

html = f"""
<div class="cw-ecocast cw-ecocast-map-page">

  <!-- PROJECT NAVIGATION -->
  <div class="cw-ecocast-topbar">

    <a class="cw-ecocast-brand" href="ecocast.html">
      <img src="images/ecocast_logo_003366.png"
           alt="EcoCast logo">
    </a>

    <nav class="cw-ecocast-tabs"
         aria-label="EcoCast navigation">

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab"
         href="about_ecocast.html">
        About EcoCast
      </a>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab is-active"
         href="ecocast_map.html"
         aria-current="page">
        EcoCast Map
      </a>

      <a class="cw-ecocast-tab"
         href="ecocast_explorer.html">
        EcoCast Explorer
      </a>

    </nav>

  </div>

  <!-- PAGE INTRODUCTION -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-map-hero">

    <span class="cw-ecocast-map-eyebrow">
      {safe(hero.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h1>{safe(hero.get('title'))}</h1>

    <p>{safe(hero.get('subtitle'))}</p>

  </section>

  
<!-- MAP VIEWER -->
<section class="cw-ecocast-map-section">

  <div class="cw-ecocast-map-toolbar">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-map-toolbar-text">
      <h2>{safe(map_data.get('title'))}</h2>
      <p>{safe(map_data.get('description'))}</p>
    </div>

    <span class="cw-ecocast-map-counter" id="mapCounter">
      1 of {len(map_dates)}
    </span>

  </div>

  <div class="cw-ecocast-map-viewer">

    <img id="mapFrame"
         src="{safe(initial_map)}"
         alt="{safe(map_data.get('image_alt'))}">

  </div>

  <div class="cw-ecocast-map-navigation">

    <button id="mapPrevious"
            class="cw-ecocast-map-nav-btn"
            type="button">
      <span aria-hidden="true">←</span>
      Previous
    </button>

    <span class="cw-ecocast-map-current" id="mapCurrent">
      {safe(initial_label)}
    </span>

    <button id="mapNext"
            class="cw-ecocast-map-nav-btn"
            type="button">
      Next
      <span aria-hidden="true">→</span>
    </button>

  </div>

</section>


  <!-- FAQ -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-map-faq">

    <div class="cw-ecocast-map-section-heading">

      <span class="cw-ecocast-map-section-label">
        {safe(faq.get('eyebrow'))}
      </span>

      <h2>{safe(faq.get('title'))}</h2>

    </div>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-map-faq-list">
      {faq_items}
    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- DOWNLOADS -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-map-downloads">

    <span class="cw-ecocast-map-section-label">
      {safe(downloads.get('eyebrow'))}
    </span>

    <h2>{safe(downloads.get('title'))}</h2>

    <p>{safe(downloads.get('description'))}</p>

    <div class="cw-ecocast-download-list">
      {download_links}
    </div>

  </section>

  <!-- DISCLAIMER -->
  <section class="cw-ecocast-about-disclaimer
                  cw-ecocast-map-disclaimer">
    {md(disclaimer.get('text'))}
  </section>

</div>
"""

display(HTML(html))


# ----------------------------------------------------------
# MAP NAVIGATION JAVASCRIPT
# ----------------------------------------------------------

map_script = """
<script>
(function () {

  const maps = __MAP_DATA__;

  let currentIndex = 0;

  const image = document.getElementById("mapFrame");
  const previous = document.getElementById("mapPrevious");
  const next = document.getElementById("mapNext");
  const currentLabel = document.getElementById("mapCurrent");
  const counter = document.getElementById("mapCounter");

  if (!image || !previous || !next || !maps.length) {
    return;
  }

  function updateMap() {

    const map = maps[currentIndex];

    image.src = map.url;
    currentLabel.textContent = map.label;
    counter.textContent =
      (currentIndex + 1) + " of " + maps.length;

    previous.disabled = currentIndex === maps.length - 1;
    next.disabled = currentIndex === 0;
  }

  previous.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (currentIndex < maps.length - 1) {
      currentIndex++;
      updateMap();
    }
  });

  next.addEventListener("click", function () {
    if (currentIndex > 0) {
      currentIndex--;
      updateMap();
    }
  });

  updateMap();

})();
</script>
"""

display(HTML(
    map_script.replace("__MAP_DATA__", map_dates_json)
))

```
